calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  s.format AS store_format,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0)) AS units_returned
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

SELECT

  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0)) AS units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0)) / SUM(f.quantity), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sales_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2

SELECT COUNT(*) AS return_lines_for_p2_sales
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS total_units_returned
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2

SELECT 
  s.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS sales_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN f.sales_line_id END) AS sales_with_returns,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.quantity_returned) / SUM(f.quantity), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY s.format
